experience.text: XSLT was developed by World Wide Web Consortium
The chairperson of World Wide Web Consortium is Tim Berners-Lee
Tim Berners-Lee is a citizen of United Kingdom
United Kingdom is located in the continent of Europe
XSLT was developed by European Broadcasting Union
The chairperson of European Broadcasting Union is Norodom Ranariddh
Norodom Ranariddh is a citizen of Israel
Israel is located in the continent of Australia
Which continent is the country in, where the chairperson of the developer of XSLT is a citizen?
